arxiv-1408-5081.title: Strain-gradient-induced switching of nanoscale domains in free-standing ultrathin films
arxiv-1408-5081.creator: G. D. Belletti, S. D. Dalosto, Silvia Tinte
arxiv-1408-5081.description: Abstract We report first-principle atomistic simulations on the effect of local strain gradients on the nanoscale domain morphology of free-standing PbTiO 3 ultrathin films. First, the ferroelectric properties of free films at the atomic level are reviewed. For the explored thicknesses (10 to 23 unit cells), we find flux-closure domain structures whose morphology is thickness dependent.

arxiv-2105-10644.title: Semi-Supervised Few-Shot Classification with Deep Invertible Hybrid Models
arxiv-2105-10644.creator: Yusuke Ohtsubo, Tetsu Matsukawa, Einoshin Suzuki
arxiv-2105-10644.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a deep invertible hybrid model which integrates discriminative and generative learning at a latent space level for semi-supervised few-shot classification. Various tasks for classifying new species from image data can be modeled as a semi-supervised few-shot classification, which assumes a labeled and unlabeled training examples and a small support set of the target classes.

arxiv-2302-03249.title: Qualitative quantum simulation of resonant tunneling and localization with the shallow quantum circuits
arxiv-2302-03249.creator: P. Wang
arxiv-2302-03249.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by P. Wang. In a circuit-based quantum computer, the computing is performed via the discrete-time evolution driven by quantum gates. Accurate simulation of continuous-time evolution requires a large number of quantum gates and therefore suffers from more noise. In this paper, we find that shallow quantum circuits are sufficient to qualitatively observe some typical quantum phenomena in the continuous-time evolution limit, such as resonant tunneling and localization phenomena. We study the propagation of a spin excitation in Trotter circuits with a large step size.

arxiv-2308-13185.title: The mid-infrared variability of the SDSS optical quasars
arxiv-2308-13185.creator: Hongtao Wang, Yong Shi †
arxiv-2308-13185.description: Abstract Based on the Seventh Data Release (DR7) quasar catalog from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey, we investigate the variability of optical quasars in W1, W2, W3 and W4 bands of the Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer (WISE) and the Near-Earth Object Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer (NEOWISE).

arxiv-2312-06375.title: Vortical currents and reciprocal relations for transport coefficients in the electron hydrodynamic regime
arxiv-2312-06375.creator: Nisarg Chadha, Subroto Mukerjee
arxiv-2312-06375.description: Abstract We investigate the hydrodynamic regime in metals with momentum-conserving electron-electron scattering. The conservation of momentum results in well-defined dynamics whose effects we investigate via the relevant continuity equations. Studying semiclassical thermoelectric transport in the presence of a Berry curvature, we find anomalous contributions to the charge and heat transport currents arising from gradients of the velocity field.

arxiv-2401-09889.title: Role of inter- and intraband current in laser interaction with bi-chromatic quasi-periodic crystals
arxiv-2401-09889.creator: Amol R. Holkundkar ID, Nivash R, Jayendra N. Bandyopadhyay ID
arxiv-2401-09889.description: Abstract We study the role of the inter- and intraband current in the laser interaction with the bi-chromatic quasi-periodic crystals. The interaction dynamics are simulated by solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation in the k k -space, and time evolution of the inter- and intraband current is obtained in a gauge invariant form.

arxiv-2410-17097.title: Flutter stability of twin-box bridge decks
arxiv-2410-17097.creator: M. Rønne, A. Larsen, J. H. Walther and S. V. Larsen
arxiv-2410-17097.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by M. Rønne, A. Larsen, J. H. Walther and S. V. Larsen. The present paper reports on wind tunnel tests and analyses carried out to investigate the effect of the static angle of attack on the aerodynamic stability of a twin-box bridge deck section. It is found that the critical wind speed for onset of flutter increases with increasing positive static angles (nose-up) and that this effect relates mainly to a decrease in the loss of aerodynamic stiffness.

arxiv-2411-09363.title: When Mamba Meets xLSTM: An Efficient and Precise Method with the xLSTM-VMUNet Model for Skin lesion Segmentation
arxiv-2411-09363.creator: Zhuoyi Fang, Jiajia Liu, Kexuan Shi, Qiang Han ∗
arxiv-2411-09363.description: Abstract Automatic melanoma segmentation is essential for early skin cancer detection, yet challenges arise from the heterogeneity of melanoma, as well as interfering factors like blurred boundaries, low contrast, and imaging artifacts. While numerous algorithms have been developed to address these issues, previous approaches have often overlooked the need to jointly capture spatial and sequential features within dermatological images.

arxiv-2505-15562.title: On Triangular Forms for x x -Flat Control-Affine Systems With Two Inputs Thanks: This research was funded in whole or in part by the Austrian Science Fund (FWF) [P36473]. For open access purposes, the author has applied a CC BY public copyright license to any author accepted manuscript version arisi
arxiv-2505-15562.creator: 1 st Georg Hartl, 2 nd Conrad Gstöttner, 3 rd Markus Schöberl
arxiv-2505-15562.description: Abstract This paper examines a broadly applicable triangular normal form for x x -flat control-affine systems with two inputs. First, we show that this triangular form encompasses a wide range of established normal forms. Next, we prove that any x x -flat system can be transformed into this triangular structure after a finite number of prolongations of each input.

arxiv-2508-18605.title: Rigidity of generic random tensegrity structures Preprint: APS/123-QED
arxiv-2508-18605.creator: Vishal Sudhakar, James P. McInerney, D. Zeb Rocklin, William Stephenson
arxiv-2508-18605.description: Abstract Many mechanical structures, both engineered and biological, combine heavy rigid elements such as bones and beams with lightweight flexible ones such as cables and membranes. These are referred to as tensegrities, reflecting that cables can only support extensile tension.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-iroquois.title: Iroquois (Catholic Encyclopedia article)
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-iroquois.creator: James Mooney
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-iroquois.description: Article 'Iroquois' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-11427878.title: Identifying Psychosocial and Ecological Determinants of Enthusiasm In Youth: Integrative Cross-Sectional Analysis Using Machine Learning
pmc-11427878.creator: Roberta M Dolling-Boreham, Akshay Mohan, Mohamed Abdelhack, Tara Elton-Marshall, Hayley A Hamilton, Angela Boak, Daniel Felsky, Amaryllis Mavragani, Yanxu Yang, Manuel Marques da Cruz
pmc-11427878.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundUnderstanding the factors contributing to mental well-being in youth is a public health priority. Self-reported enthusiasm for the future may be a useful indicator of well-being and has been shown to forecast social and educational success. Typically, cross-domain measures of ecological and health-related factors with relevance to public policy and programming are analyzed either in isolation or in targeted models assessing bivariate interactions.

pmc-11640992.title: Prescription Design of Sinomenine Gel Based on Molecular Dynamics Simulations
pmc-11640992.creator: Yiran Kang, Wei Shen, Shili Pan, Haiying Lian, Xuehui Ding, Jingying Li, Jiaoyue Zhu, Lin Wang, Wei Xu, Silvana Alfei
pmc-11640992.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Sinomenine (SIN) is a drug for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, most of which is administered orally, but it is prone to adverse gastrointestinal effects. Gel can overcome the gastrointestinal adverse effects caused by oral administration. In this paper, a multiscale computational pharmaceutics strategy was developed to guide the systematic study of formulation factors of a SIN gel and, further, to guide the formulation design.

pmc-11657743.title: HPV11 targeting KDM4A regulates the polarization of macrophage M1 and promotes the development of nasal inverted papilloma
pmc-11657743.creator: Liying Zheng, Baoji Hu, Wenhao Yao, Kaisai Tian, Gaohan Zhu, Mingming Jin, Shuixian Huang, Xiaoping Chen, Yi Zhang
pmc-11657743.description: The development of nasal inverted papilloma (NIP) is closely related to human papillomavirus (HPV) infection. Previous studies indicated that HPV11 shows the highest expression in NIP tissues. However, the mechanisms following its integration into host DNA require further clarification. In this study, high-throughput sequencing was employed to identify the HPV integration site KDM4A in HPV-positive specimens.

pmc-12386639.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Expressional Analysis of the TIFY Gene Family in Eucalyptus grandis
pmc-12386639.creator: Chunxia Lei, Yingtong Huang, Rui An, Chunjie Fan, Sufang Zhang, Aimin Wu, Yue Jing, Peng Zhao
pmc-12386639.description: The TIFY gene family participates in crucial processes including plant development, stress adaptation, and hormonal signaling cascades. While the TIFY gene family has been extensively characterized in model plant systems and agricultural crops, its functional role in Eucalyptus grandis, a commercially valuable tree species of significant ecological and economic importance, remains largely unexplored.

pmc-12402223.title: “Good” fats, bad news: HDL-delivered vitamin E shields tumors from ferroptosis
pmc-12402223.creator: Dong Wook Choi, Eun-Woo Lee
pmc-12402223.description: ance ferroptosis-based cancer therapies. Dynamic reprogramming of cellular metabolic pathways is a hallmark of cancer. Among these, cancer cells actively exploit a diverse range of lipid species, not only as essential biosynthetic precursors (e.g., membrane lipids) and metabolic fuels, but also for maintaining cellular redox homeostasis.

pmc-12546974.title: The upregulation of GDF15 is controlled epigenetically by oncogenic TCF19 signaling in human hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-12546974.creator: Yongqian Liu, Caiyu Yong, Mengyu Yang, Haoxiang Qi, Sijie Zheng, Menglan Wang, Xu Huang, Shujuan Zhao, Qiyi Zhang, Jianwei Han, Jie Ying, Heng Dong, Jianxiang Chen
pmc-12546974.description: SummaryGrowth differentiation factor 15 (GDF15) plays an important role in the progression of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and chronic liver disease, but its regulatory mechanisms are still unclear. Here, we found that the histone methylation reader protein transcription factor 19 (TCF19) was significantly positively correlated with and regulated GDF15 expression.

pmc-13103486.title: Clinical efficacy of comprehensive traditional Chinese medicine in adjuvant therapy for stage Ib-IIIa resected non-small cell lung cancer: a multi-center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
pmc-13103486.creator: Liping Shen, Yi Jiang, Xiaofeng Yang, Yuqing Cai, Ruoyan Qin, Xiaoli Xin, Juhua Yin, Xiangyan Bi, Peng Zhang, Aiqin Gu, Lei Jiang, Hecheng Li, ChunJie Li, Lingshuang Liu
pmc-13103486.description: BackgroundRecurrence and metastasis after radical resection for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remain a significant cause of treatment failure. Comprehensive Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) has emerged as a vital therapeutic approach in China. This study evaluated the efficacy and safety of TCM treatment with platinum-based adjuvant chemotherapy for patients of stage IB-IIIA resected NSCLC.

pmc-13113047.title: Openness to discussing mental health is negatively associated with suicidal ideation among South Korean college students
pmc-13113047.creator: Subin Park, Jinyeong Park, Hi Jae Lee, JiYeon Choi, Philip Hyland, Thanos Karatzias, Mark Shevlin, Sang Hui Chu
pmc-13113047.description: BackgroundCollege students are particularly vulnerable to mental health challenges, including depression, anxiety, and suicidal ideation. This study aims to (1) examine the prevalence of suicidal ideation and describe perceived barriers to mental health service utilization among South Korean college students, and (2) identify factors associated with suicidal ideation.

pmc-13328469.title: Outcomes from the ASPEN intervention program: a randomized clinical trial of a culturally adapted parent-mediated intervention program in low-resource settings
pmc-13328469.creator: Sandra B. Vanegas, Sandy Magaña

pmc-13374176.title: Application of Q-methodology in chronic disease research: a scoping review
pmc-13374176.creator: Li Zhang, Xue Yang, Guirong Li

pmc-13376480.title: How are agency and autonomy understood in children’s palliative and end-of-life care?: A narrative review
pmc-13376480.creator: Sydney Campbell, Lauren Delaney, Nika Rovensky, Ryan Kent, Amarens Matthiesen, Franco A Carnevale, Mary Ellen Macdonald
pmc-13376480.description: Public policy in Canada develops through deliberative democracy and, increasingly, public engagement. Children and youth (‘young people’) remain largely excluded from these processes however; this exclusion is especially evident in health arenas where two conceptual tools, autonomy and agency, are used to justify it.

pmc-13440624.title: Structure-based redesign enables clinical translation of CAIX-targeted theranostics in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
pmc-13440624.creator: Zexin Xu, Hui Zhou, Ye Dong, Dan Feng, Baocheng Chen, Hongxin Li, Ruitao Yang, Ningjie Li, Yuting Cao, Hankuan He, Han Wu, Yuhua Zhong, Hubing Wu, Liang Zhao, Haojun Chen, Kongzhen Hu
pmc-13440624.description: Carbonic anhydrase IX (CAIX) is an interesting therapeutic target in clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), but gastrointestinal uptake impedes the clinical translation of CAIX-targeted radioligand. In this study, structure-guided optimization of a cyclic peptide scaffold was conducted to decouple tumor targeting from gastrointestinal retention.

uslaw-usc-t49-s30112.title: 49 U.S.C. § 30112 — Prohibitions on manufacturing, selling, and importing noncomplying motor vehicles and equipment
uslaw-usc-t49-s30112.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s30112.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part A (General); Chapter 301 (Motor Vehicle Safety); Subchapter II (Standards And Compliance). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) General.— (1) Except as provided in this section, sections 30113 and 30114 of this title, and subchapter III of this chapter, a person may not manufacture for sale, sell, offer for sale, introduce or deliver for introduction.
